messages:
sam: Heads up — bringing up hf/eleven-lite on staging and seeing streaming responses terminate mid-sentence sometimes when using our chat template. Not deterministic but more frequent with quantized build.
ana: Ugh. Any logs or reproducer?
sam: Yeah, noticed stop sequences being matched across chunk boundaries. Example log: `... generated tokens: [824, 1, 50256, 178]` then streamer emits text up to token 50256 which is `` and cuts. But sometimes the tokenizer splits the sentinel across two sub-tokens so we never see `50256` in a single chunk.
jun: Do you have the tokenizer config we used? HF->Redwood mapping might have special_tokens mismatch.
sam: Config excerpt from model repo: ```json
{"eos_token": "", "bos_token": "", "pad_token": "<|pad|>"}
```
sam: Our chat template uses stop_sequences: ["\nUser:"] and also we add `` as a hard stop. If that ends up split `""` -> [`"`, ""] across streaming segments, our stop matcher fires on the first piece incorrectly.
liz: Wait — how does the streamer match stops? Is it naive substring on each chunk?
sam: Right now we do incremental substring match on each emitted chunk; we don't buffer across chunk boundaries beyond last 64 chars. That buffer size might be too small for certain multibyte token decodes.
ana: Could quantization change tokenization boundaries? I thought quant affects weights only.
jun: Quant doesn't change tokenizer, but we changed tokenizer version earlier when converting. There was a `do_lower_case` flag mismatch and an extra `added_tokens.json` mapped `` -> ["<|end|>"] during conversion. That mapping can create multi-token sentinel sequences.
sam: Repro steps I used: 1) deploy converted HF model with our redwood-convert tool 2) call /v1/chat.stream with template that has stop `` as well as stop "\nUser:" 3) observe early termination in ~1/5 runs on short contexts.
liz: Any snippet of the streamer behavior?
sam: paste: ```
STREAM CHUNK [0.023s]: "Hello, here's a quick answer"
STREAM CHUNK [0.045s]: "\n\n"
STREAM CHUNK [0.046s]: "User: thanks
Assistant:"  <-- we stop here due to `` appearing split
```
ana: So the sentinel spans boundary: chunk2 ends with `\n\n` which our decoder interprets as `` because of tokenizer mapping?
jun: Looks like the converted `eos_token` got fused with newline in the merged added_tokens entry. I've seen `added_tokens.json` where `` was represented as two tokens in tokenizers v0.12. Will inspect.
liz: Quick mitigation: expand buffer to 256 chars and only fire stop when match occurs on the concatenated buffer rather than per-chunk. Also add fuzzy matching guard for multi-token stops.
sam: Tried buffer=256 — reduced rate but still flaky under small batch sizes (we stream earlier).
\un-deploy-bot: deploy started for staging/model-hf-elm-lite @sam
sam: Also saw cases where multiple EOS tokens come consecutively (model emits `50256, 50256`) — our matcher treats first as stop and immediately closes stream, but client expects one final newline after all EOS tokens. Need to normalize consecutive eos collapse.
jun: Two separate fixes: 1) canonicalize stop tokens to raw text using the tokenizer and perform text-level match on the accumulated buffer. 2) in runtime, when we see an EOS token id, delay termination until decoder flushes any pending subtoken pieces (brief 1-2ms window) and check if next token is also EOS.
liz: Also add an eval that streams responses and asserts no early truncation on a prompt suite with split sentinels. Add unit test that simulates tokenizer returning half stop in chunk 1 and half in chunk 2.
ana: For HF->Redwood converter: ensure `added_tokens.json` entries are preserved and `special_tokens_map.json` is translated to our `config.json` `eos_token_id`/`eos_token` correctly. I can add a conversion step to flatten multi-token special tokens into explicit text stops used by the platform.
\sam: Thanks. I'll open a tiny PR with: - bump buffer to 512 default (configurable) - change stop matching to use tokenizer.decode on tail buffer - add a short delay-on-eos heuristic - add new tests.
jun: SGTM. Could you also log token-level ids in failing cases (scrubbed) so we can see if quantized backend reorders ldims?
\sam: will do. Tagging @liz to review tests. :thumbsup:
liz: will review. if CI flaps, revert buffer increase and land tokenizer decode path first.
ana: Note: update docs about conversion caveat — "special tokens may be multi-token in certain tokenizer versions; prefer text-based stop sequences".
sam: filing a ticket with reproducer and logs. Thanks everyone.
